advisory_notice: All SQA findings, rankings and assessments are recommendations. Master decides whether, when and how to act through docs/plan.json.
priority_assessment: Master took cells-retry/reach before hash-once/do. That order made sense. The original retry case now works and the dry run and background fill share hashes. With the plan empty, I would let the measurement at 3a7b3877d finish with the 95 cell results it has kept. The November 25 workflow recording put first-pass text-to-image at 18.521 s against ComfyUI's 13.552 s. Neither landing measures a change in that gap.

I would finish SQA-524 first. A partial scorecard can still hide a failed first measurement at the size a user requests. SQA-526 comes next because it requires a mutable input to change during a resumed run. Both cases fit existing selection and credit fixtures without another GPU draw.

findings.input: The previous scorecard has no image-gen reading for a listed, untrained MOSS model. Only cmd/server changed since that record. The first-measurement rule selects image-proof and image-user-size. The proof succeeds, the 1024 x 1024 request fails transiently, and the cycle publishes the proof's valid timing. Interrupt before fill clears cycle credit, then resume at the same commit and store.
findings.expected: Use the pre-attempt scorecard for the first-measurement decision in both list and reach selection. The successful proof keeps its cell credit and the user-size cell stays due until measured. The existing retry fixture can check which cells survive selection with an older scorecard and a partial publication.
findings.actual: On a6e5c740f, cells-retry/reach fixes the original case where a source change reached the model. In this first-measurement case reachedFrom correctly returns the older commit, and cmd/server reaches neither image cell. Both calls to Plan.Chosen still use lastRecord for readBefore. The proof's timing satisfies that model-and-task lookup for both cells, so the reach filter drops the failed user-size request before credit is consulted. The cells phase can pass without it. This is a source counterexample.

findings.input: Resume with valid credit for a guard cell at the same commit and store, a registered local weights file and a current discovery memo. After the dry run hashes the original weights, overwrite the same path with different bytes of the same size and restore its modification time. The cells phase binds the still-registered model under the same run record.
findings.expected: At the point of granting prior credit, require evidence that the mutable input still has the credited bytes. Keep the shared digest for inputs whose contents are pinned. Where identity cannot be established, revalidate the affected input or withhold its credit. Exercise the existing changed-weights credit case with the run record enabled.
findings.actual: On a6e5c740f, runDigests returns the dry run's digest by path. consumedFiles finds that digest and constructs the old cell key. executeMeasured sees credit.has and counts the cell as acquired without opening its weights. TestARunHashesEachModelFileOnce explicitly expects a within-run overwrite to preserve the binding. TestResumedRunStartsAgainACellWhoseWeightsChanged checks the opposite credit decision without the digest record. This is a source counterexample. No file change was observed in the active run.

SQA-524.note: Answered again by the lead on 2026-11-28 at a6e5c740f, for the finding as reopened: valid from source, the lead's cure falling short (Plan.Chosen still judged a retry's first readings against its own partial publication, so a failed first reading at a person's size whose model and task the proof's timing answered there was dropped). Fixed in the measurement flow every retry takes, so filed despite a second round. Implemented by compared-earlier/do, the landing that carries this answer: the whole run is compared with the newest record of a commit other than the one checked out (reachedFrom), its contracts, promotion, reach and kept first readings alike; lastRecord goes (TestARunIsComparedWithAnEarlierCommitsRecord), for the review's recheck.

SQA-526.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28 at a6e5c740f: valid from source (within a run a file is identified once, by path, so a model file overwritten during the run keeps its first digest and its cell's credit). Declined: identifying each file once a run is hash-once's purpose, and a model file is never written in place, the model store being kept and never written through (owner doctrine); a file changed within one run is no case a run supports, and the next run binds it afresh.
